source.content:
The dracthyr evokers are something unique in Azeroth: beings created specifically to wield the combined magical legacy of all five dragonflights. Born from Neltharion's ambition, they were designed as weapons and then sealed away, only to awaken in a changed world. As evokers, they have learned to channel draconic magic through their breath, fire and frost and arcane and time and life, in ways no other spellcaster can match.

They are simultaneously ancient and new, carrying the power of dragonkind in mortal form.
